aisf.name: Associazione Italiana Studenti di Fisica
aisf.description: The Italian Association of Physics Students is a non-profit cultural organization founded in 2014 with the goal of creating a national network among physics students and promoting science, especially physics. Its 1,400 members are divided across 16 local committees in Italian universities.
